standard_prerequisites.name: Injectivity on the conormal level
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies I/mI -> J/mJ injective for the presentation data I subset J.

standard_prerequisites.name: Smoothness from the naive cotangent complex
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the freeness of NL_{C/A} (x)_A B into an open neighbourhood smooth over A.

core_obligations: Set up B = R/K with R a localized polynomial algebra; form the ideals I subset J in (R (x)_A R)_m and get I/mI -> J/mJ injective.
Show f_1 (x) 1, ..., 1 (x) f_r form a minimal generating set of I (Nakayama basis computation on the fibre).
Expand f_i (x) 1 - 1 (x) f_i in the diagonal generators; the coefficient matrix (a_ij) is the image of the partial-derivative matrix.

Injectivity forces (a_ij) of maximal rank r; the naive cotangent complex of C = A[x]/(f) is (C^r -> C^n) with Jacobian differential, hence free of rank n - r after tensoring with B; conclude by the smooth-at-point lemma.
proof_roadmap: Run the four-stage argument: presentation data, minimal generators, Jacobian identification, rank maximality closing in the cotangent complex.
difficulty_reason: Long but fully displayed; the two omitted sub-identifications are standard and template-backed, the surrounding architecture is complete.
